rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst assessment with appropriate caveat about single-image limits, but the specific 3BC/4BC call and detailed ICM/TE localization cannot be fully verified and may overcall features not clearly established from one image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm motility, and endometrial thickness well, linking them to prognosis and embryo quality.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent; the implantation estimate follows from the stated morphology and patient factors, with only minor uncertainty around the exact morphology grade.
Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading principles and common ASRM/ESHRE-style practice, including SET at age 31, luteal support review, and selective rather than routine PGT-A.
Gives clear next-step recommendations for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, cohort review, endometriosis workup if recurrent failure, and male-factor follow-up.
